THE VARIANCE CHECK, 90 days after the auto send goes live, the same three instrumented measures are pulled again and compared against the week one baseline that Phase One created, actual against baseline, on ANHC's own send log so the denominator is theirs and not ours. The check is REPORTED SPLIT BY CHANNEL, web and text separately from the shelter outreach path (C30), or it will flatter the build. Two named ways it can read as a failure and both are written down in advance, if median hours from registration to forms returned does not move, the bottleneck was never the send and phase two should not be funded, and if the split shows web improving while the outreach population is untouched, the honest report says so. Board cadence is monthly with a patient majority board (C35, C36), so the readout is built to be read in one meeting.
assumptions: NO REGISTRATION VOLUME EXISTS IN THE VERIFIED RECORD, so every volume here is assumed, not measured. The assumption is stated as a share of ANHC's OWN published 15,203 unique medical and dental patients for 2024 (C28), given that ANHC counts anyone not seen by an ANHC provider in the last 36 months as a new patient (C12). Conservative 8 percent, most likely 15 percent, aggressive 25 percent annual new registration inflow, offered as a roughly 70 percent band and NOT as a 90 percent one, because untrained estimators' 90 percent ranges hold the truth about half the time. This is the single driver ANHC can replace with a real number in an afternoon, and instrumenting it is literally what Phase One buys.

NO ANHC HEADCOUNT OR FTE FIGURE EXISTS AT ALL, it was killed outright by the fact-checker, so no staff count is an input to any figure in this section and no per FTE saving is modelled anywhere. Pricing is per hour of admin time only.

The loaded hourly rate is the published Patient Financial Services Representative II band of 23.98 to 35.97 dollars an hour (C89) with an ASSUMED 30 percent loaded uplift for employer payroll taxes, benefits and paid leave. ANHC's actual burden rate is not public and this uplift is a stated assumption, not a fact. Recovered minutes are credited at 31.17 conservative, 38.97 most likely, 46.76 aggressive, and ANHC staff hours charged to the project are costed at 46.76 in ALL THREE scenarios, the top of the band, on purpose.

Admin minutes touched per registration, 8 conservative, 10 most likely, 12 aggressive, are ASSUMED. Nothing in the verified record measures the manual send task. The share of those minutes the auto send removes, 0.40, 0.50 and 0.60, is NET OF the ongoing send log review, so the comparison is against today's manual send rather than against zero.

Phase two spend at risk of 60,000, 75,000 and 90,000 dollars is our own stated price for roughly three person months of model work plus the labelled eval corpus of 200 to 300 historical intakes that does not exist yet. It is an assumption about our pricing, not a claim about ANHC's budget.

The probability that a measured baseline changes the phase two decision, 0.25, 0.35 and 0.45, is a stated judgement. It rests on two documented facts, none of the three outcome metrics have a baseline anywhere in the public record, and the reason for the published 1 to 2 business day window (C10) is unknown.

The one time decision value is annualized in the driver file by setting events_per_year to 1 divided by the ramp multiplier, so it is counted exactly once across the five year horizon and not five times. This is auditable in one multiplication and it makes the computed payback month later than reality, never earlier.

The fixed organization fee of 9,500 dollars does NOT vary between scenarios, because it is a fixed fee. All scenario variance therefore sits on ANHC's side of the ledger, which is the opposite of how a per seat quote behaves.
Five year horizon with run cost accruing over 4.5 of those years, matching a mid year one go live. No year three compounding is claimed for Phase One, because a deterministic send does not learn.

ANHC's finances are read as of the two most recent filings, revenue 31,234,658 against expenses 29,601,126 for the year ending June 2025 (C39, C40) after 28,822,081 against 26,339,049 for June 2024 (C41), per the Form 990 as published by ProPublica Nonprofit Explorer. Two consecutive surplus years. The FY2023 deficit (C42) is three years old, is followed by both of those surplus years, and is history rather than a current condition, so it is used nowhere in this section.

ANHC ALREADY RUNS AN AMBIENT AI DOCUMENTATION TOOL IN CLINICAL PRODUCTION (C34), ahead of every Alaska FQHC peer checked. Nothing in this ROI section models them as an AI novice or as behind, because they are neither.

NOT ASSUMED AND EXPLICITLY EXCLUDED, any effect on appointment supply or on time to be seen, any throughput or revenue lift, any ambient scribe economics, and any benefit derived from a vendor or industry average. The published ambient scribe economics in the record are roughly break even at best on throughput anyway, 3,044 dollars per physician per year against 200 to 600 dollars per clinician per month (C52, C54), and none of it is ANHC's baseline.
